purpose: IESVE transport candidate from MeteoSwiss hourly climate CSV

source.license: CC BY 4.0; attribution required by GVE_Metadata.csv

field_mapping.global_horizontal: CSV gls hourly mean -> hourly Wh/m2
field_mapping.diffuse_horizontal: CSV str.diffus hourly mean -> hourly Wh/m2
field_mapping.direct_normal: CSV str.direkt hourly mean -> hourly Wh/m2
field_mapping.opaque_sky_cover: Total sky cover used as explicit proxy
field_mapping.dew_point: Derived from dry bulb and RH using NOAA MADIS equations
field_mapping.station_pressure: Standard atmosphere derived from MeteoSwiss station elevation

warnings: This is a transport conversion, not an official MeteoSwiss/SIA EPW.
The CSV contains no measured station pressure; standard elevation pressure is used.
Opaque sky cover is unavailable; total sky cover is used as a proxy.
Precipitation snow illuminance and ground temperatures are unavailable.
The source is a 365-day climate year; 2060 omits leap day by source design.
IESVE WeatherFileReader read-back is mandatory before assignment.
Regulatory suitability and scenario selection require reviewer confirmation.
